{{Quotation|game|In the icy Shiverpeaks, fighting gladiator-style is the best way for heroes to stay warm while sharpening their reflexes and earning the respect and admiration of their peers and the public. The Shiverpeak Arena is one of two in this frozen mountain range.}}

The [[Shiverpeak Arena (outpost)|Shiverpeak Arena]] is a [[Player versus Player|PvP]] arena located north of [[Yak's Bend]].

==Description==
Players start on opposing sides of the map. The geography of this arena consists of a snow covered bowl with a frozen creek in the center.

===Arena Rules===
* Maximum Character Level Allowed: 15
* Team Size: 4
* Teams are selected randomly.
* No Elite Skills Allowed

==NPCs==
===Allies===
====Services====
*{{x}} 10 [[Willem]] ([[Priest of Balthazar]])

==Notes==
* The second arena mentioned in the description is the now defunct [[Deldrimor Arena]] that was once located in [[Droknar's Forge]].
* There is a small part of map that can be explored if you enter the arena (including the battle area). This will contribute about 0.1% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title.

==Trivia==
*An altered version of this map is used for [[Dwayna vs Grenth]].
